## Checklist

- [ ] Canonical section order intact (rule, triggers, origin, protocol,
      failure modes, worked example, boundaries, missing piece, changelog)
- [ ] Frontmatter has exactly `name` and `description`; description is
      1024 characters or fewer
- [ ] No proper nouns in skill bodies; English only; no CJK characters
      anywhere
- [ ] Under 500 lines
- [ ] Changelog line appended with version bump and date
- [ ] Tone passes anti-sycophancy-baseline: dry, precise, no exclamation
      marks
